note: Sullivan County PA does not publish a county zoning layer; the county GIS and planning pages list only parcel, topology and subdivision material, and zoning is left to municipalities. The only municipal zoning found is Eagles Mere Borough's zoning map, a downloadable PDF, and its 1988 ordinance, a PDF in the PA e-Library. No queryable zoning district service was found for Laporte, Dushore or the townships.
